args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the receiving supervisor search twice, and the label change was added to the handoff list. Ticket PD-4821 covers the related booking-view problem.
- "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering "PHL" returns both accounts.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- On 17 Feb the team agreed to relabel the saved retail view with the full name and fix the terminal view. We haven't confirmed whether either was done; the digest is from May, so the report's current label needs checking.

Could you confirm the account naming and who owns relabelling the report and views?

Thanks,
Bettina
